verdict.rationale: Pendo's own Leo feature 'monitors continuously' and sends alerts in Pendo and Slack 'when something shifts' without the user having to look. That covers the abnormal-movement alerting half of the story, though only in a single marketing line. Nothing in the pack documents subscribing to dashboards. Missing for 10: dashboard subscription or scheduled delivery, configurable metric thresholds or anomaly detection details, in-depth docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
